definition: what a goal is for someone with no future to be pulled toward

settled:
Nothing stands in for a future I cannot picture. What drives me is pain now, including the pain of a want I cannot have.

So holding a goal means capturing that pain where it can be lit again, not keeping a want in mind.

Reading the record does not remind me. It makes the present me want it again.

An entry that fails to light dies quietly, and that is the filter. What truly matters comes back on its own, because the world is the backup store.

I am a serial quitter. When interest drops I stop, and where the thing truly matters the interest returns and I begin again. My persistence runs in quit-and-restart cycles over long stretches rather than as steady forward effort.

The blind spot is drift that never hurts in any one moment. Health sliding slowly, a relationship quietly cooling. Each single moment is fine, so nothing ever escalates and the drift compounds unwatched.

I am building pings for it, which is the same move as everywhere else: where I get no signal, engineer one.
